items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png) **A Week in Ashfield** is a series of five competitions from December 27, 2024 to December 31, 2024. You may only compete in one of these five competitions. They are listed below. [A Friday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AFridayinAshfield2024) (12/27/2024) [A Saturday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ASaturdayinAshfield2024) (12/28/2024) [A Sunday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ASundayinAshfield2024) (12/29/2024) [A Monday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AMondayinAshfield2024) (12/30/2024) [A Tuesday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ATuesdayinAshfield2024) (12/31/2024) This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions) * [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435) * [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

items.name: Twixmas Flen 2024

venue.name: Amazon
venue.details: Enter from the back, on the hill.

items.information: Välkomna till Twixmas Flen 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** På fredagen hålls endast ett försök 3x3 Multi-BLD. Om du inte tävlar i den grenen behöver du inte komma redan på fredagen, utan det räcker att du kommer först innan din första gren ska börja på lördagen. ----- Welcome to Twixmas Flen 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Uzbekistan Nationals 2024
items.information: **English** This competition is the National Championship of Uzbekistan. Anyone can participate, but only citizens of Uzbekistan can win prizes. Please read all the information very carefully before registering. **Russian** Эти соревнования являются национальным чемпионатом. Участвовать может любой желающий, но только граждане Узбекистана могут выиграть призы. Пожалуйста, перед регистрацией прочтите всю информацию очень внимательно.
